# Governed cloud delivery pipelines

Repository-to-deployment engineering and review for the declared delivery boundary.

## Promotion

Record source revision, pipeline version, build identity, build and test evidence, provenance and immutable artifact digest. Check repository integration, service support, regional availability, release identity and credential scope before production use. Bind the existing change authority to the exact reviewed release, environment and artifact. Independently observe rollout health and reversal.

<!-- SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-4-Clause -->
<!-- Copyright (c) 2026 Leo Galambos and the Egothor team -->

# AWS governed cloud delivery pipelines

Repository-to-deployment CI/CD using an explicitly supported AWS target.

Use CodeCommit where eligible or a supported external repository connection through CodeConnections. CodePipeline orchestrates CodeBuild and the ECS standard deploy action for this path. Store container images in Amazon ECR and use CodeArtifact for applicable packages. Bind image digest to deployment input and record the previous completed task definition and circuit breaker outcome. Check CodeDeploy separately for service and deployment controller combinations using blue-green.

[Amazon ECS standard deployment action](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/codepipeline/latest/userguide/action-reference-ECS.html)

<!-- SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-4-Clause -->
<!-- Copyright (c) 2026 Leo Galambos and the Egothor team -->

# Microsoft Azure governed cloud delivery pipelines

Repository-to-deployment CI/CD using an explicitly supported Microsoft Azure target.

Use Azure Repos, Azure Pipelines and Azure Artifacts for applicable package feeds. Publish immutable pipeline evidence and promote the same image digest from Azure Container Registry to Container Apps. Configure environment approvals outside pipeline YAML. Scope the workload identity federation service connection and verify the previous revision and traffic allocation for reversal. Record whether Boards and Test Plans are applicable.

[Azure Pipelines approvals and checks](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/devops/pipelines/process/approvals)

<!-- SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-4-Clause -->
<!-- Copyright (c) 2026 Leo Galambos and the Egothor team -->

# Google Cloud governed cloud delivery pipelines

Repository-to-deployment CI/CD using an explicitly supported Google Cloud target.

Use Secure Source Manager or a supported Cloud Build repository connection. Cloud Source Repositories requires existing eligibility. Build in Cloud Build, store immutable images in Artifact Registry and promote the same Cloud Deploy release to its Cloud Run target. Bind release and rollout IDs, execution identity and previous successful release for rollback.

[Deploy your application](https://docs.cloud.google.com/deploy/docs/deploying-application)

# Cloud infrastructure and landing-zone evidence

Cloud estate commissioning, transition and independent assessment for the declared target.

## Commission

Use attributable requirements for greenfield. For on-premises migration capture observed dependencies, connectivity, coexistence, continuity and tested reversal. For estate assessment review actual versus intended controls and distinguish evidence gaps from supported findings.

<!-- SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-4-Clause -->
<!-- Copyright (c) 2026 Leo Galambos and the Egothor team -->

# AWS cloud infrastructure and landing-zone evidence

AWS architecture and engineering in a bounded target environment.

Pin organization, organizational unit, account and Region. Establish the actual Control Tower or independently operated landing-zone scope. Record controls and observability coverage in each target account and Region.

[AWS Control Tower user guide](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/controltower/latest/userguide/what-is-control-tower.html)

<!-- SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-4-Clause -->
<!-- Copyright (c) 2026 Leo Galambos and the Egothor team -->

# Microsoft Azure cloud infrastructure and landing-zone evidence

Microsoft Azure architecture and engineering in a bounded target environment.

Pin tenant, management group, subscription and region. Map placement, policy assignment and exceptions to hierarchy. Document network, identity, logging and service ownership with the applicable Azure landing-zone decisions.

[Azure landing zone](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/cloud-adoption-framework/ready/landing-zone/)

<!-- SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-4-Clause -->
<!-- Copyright (c) 2026 Leo Galambos and the Egothor team -->

# Google Cloud cloud infrastructure and landing-zone evidence

Google Cloud architecture and engineering in a bounded target environment.

Pin organization, folder, project and location. Identify inherited organization policies, shared networking and per-project identities. Record audit routing, data locations and backup or recovery ownership.

[Enterprise foundations blueprint](https://docs.cloud.google.com/architecture/blueprints/security-foundations)

# Zero Trust resource access and transition

Resource access design, migration or independent assessment with a versioned scoped baseline.

## Inventory

Version the subject, workload and device identities, resources, observed flows, dependencies and accountable owners. Record source, observation window, confidence and coverage gaps. Derive measurable access and availability criteria from attributable requirements.

[SP 800-207 Zero Trust Architecture](https://csrc.nist.gov/pubs/sp/800/207/final)

## Decisions

Document subject and resource identity, device or workload posture, context signals and trust assumptions for each access decision. Map each policy decision to an enforcement point. Specify expected allow, deny and unavailable-signal outcomes and evidence for each.

[SP 800-207 Zero Trust Architecture](https://csrc.nist.gov/pubs/sp/800/207/final)

<!-- SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-4-Clause -->
<!-- Copyright (c) 2026 Leo Galambos and the Egothor team -->

# Zero Trust transition and reversal

Sequence coexistence by wave and bound residual classic access. Identify exception owners, exact scope, expiry and monitoring. Specify continuity objectives, halt triggers, reversal steps and independently measured recovery outcomes. Preserve separation of design and assessment.

[Zero Trust Maturity Model 2.0](https://www.cisa.gov/resources-tools/resources/zero-trust-maturity-model)

# Terraform governed plans and state

Terraform infrastructure engineering for an explicitly selected tool version, providers and backend.

## Constraints

Pin Terraform, provider constraints and lock file checksums. Version reusable modules with declared inputs, outputs and upgrade tests. Verify provider and backend support in the exact account, region and tool version.

[Terraform state locking](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/state/locking)

## State

Assign ownership of a versioned and access-controlled state backend. Confirm that the backend supports locking and establish an incident procedure for lock recovery. Minimize sensitive values and protect state and saved plan material as sensitive.

[Terraform state locking](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/state/locking)

## Promotion

Validate and review the saved plan before effect. Bind its digest to the source and provider lock file, state identity, target environment and reviewed change scope. Replan after drift or a changed input. Apply the exact saved plan only with applicable prior authority and collect reconciliation and recovery evidence.

[Terraform state locking](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/state/locking)

<!-- SPDX-License-Identifier: BSD-4-Clause -->
<!-- Copyright (c) 2026 Leo Galambos and the Egothor team -->

# OpenTofu compatibility evidence

Identify OpenTofu separately when selected. Recheck providers, state and plan compatibility, encryption and the applicable licenses for exact tool and module versions. Treat compatible configurations as evidence to verify rather than a portability assurance.

[OpenTofu introduction](https://opentofu.org/docs/intro/)
